不想为了管理任务，再填一套表: no extra forms just to manage tasks
最开始，Pi 管知识库，WorkBuddy 做交付，采集和测试还会换着用其他 A: At first, Pi maintained the knowledge base and WorkBuddy handled delivery. Other agents took turns collecting and testing. They worked in separate windows; everything between those windows was my job.
我想做个工作台，看清报告该给谁、哪边还没读。结果第一版让我多录一遍任务，手动负担: I wanted a workbench showing who needed each report and what remained unread. The first version made me enter tasks twice, adding manual work. Later I connected the real folders and created cards for incoming reports, while still copying, handing off and confirming things myself.
再往后，审计报告放错目录、找不到批量按钮、同名文件被认成旧任务，这些问题都是用起: Misplaced audit reports, hard-to-find batch controls and duplicate filenames mistaken for old tasks only surfaced through actual use.
TS 跑起来以后，我把 KS 也接进来。: Once TS was running, I added KS.
同一个平台，两条业务线。用法可以一样，: One platform, two business lines. The workflow could be shared, but
资料和任务得各管各的: their documents and tasks had to stay separate
我想往回找一件事是怎么走到这里的，于是有了事项链：材料从哪里来，派过什么任务，测: I wanted to trace how something reached its current state. That led to linked activity records: where material came from, which tasks were assigned and who received the test results. Unrecorded historical links stayed unknown.
KS 的文件夹和 TS 很像，却不完全一样。核对实际目录以后，我才把它接进来。操: KS folders resembled TS, but weren't identical. I checked the actual directories before connecting them. The workflow was shared; tasks, databases and originals remained separate.
“等待沟通”那套流程，我一次也没用过；真正每天在做的是外部交接。我让普通看板回到: I never used the 'waiting for communication' workflow. External handoffs were the daily reality. I restored the ordinary three-column board and tucked away extra forms. Weekly reviews brought together that week's relevant material.
我想让它们自己聊，结果没走通。: I tried letting the agents talk. It didn't work out.
接口能回复，任务却未必投到正确位置。我决定: An API reply didn't mean a task reached the right place. I decided to
先停下，回到人工协调: pause and return to manual coordination
我从把采集报告自动交给 Pi 开始试。空会话认不出来，机器回执又挤掉中文报告，做: I started by automatically handing collection reports to Pi. Empty sessions went unrecognized, machine receipts displaced Chinese reports and the confirmation entry was hard to find. A seemingly simple handoff needed several patches.
后来我想让 Agent 自动来回沟通，最后交给我一个结论。但按当时的接入方式，消: Next I wanted agents to exchange messages and return a conclusion. With the integration then in place, some messages never reached the intended business workspace. After checking where execution actually happened, I stopped the automatic exchanges.
正式发布的 V3.0 继续做人工分类和批量交接。剪贴板丢了能找回，同一件事别催我: The V3.0 release kept manual classification and batch handoffs. Clipboard contents became recoverable, with fewer repeated reminders. After a detour integrating the Mac, it handled collection only; I manually returned results to the original entry point.
换出去试了一圈，当晚又回了 WPS。: I tried moving away, then returned to WPS that evening.
流转要等云端内容读回来: waiting for cloud content during handoffs
。回退时，白天做过的事也得保住。: . Rolling back also had to preserve the day's work.
我想多试试工具，WPS 会员又快到期了，云盘空间也吃紧，就把原来的文件架构复制一: I wanted to try more tools. With my WPS subscription expiring and cloud storage tight, I copied the existing folder structure to Feishu. I left the originals intact so I could roll back.
真用起来，闭环和归档等很久。这次适配里，云端读取占着数据库写锁，重名文件又会挡住: In practice, closing and archiving took too long. Cloud reads held a database write lock, duplicate filenames blocked whole sync batches, and an unprepared local mirror was mistaken for missing originals. After several fixes, I still asked to roll back that evening.
退回去也得接回当天新增、更新和归档的材料，保留任务与历史。后面继续改提示词、换维: The rollback had to carry back new, updated and archived material while preserving tasks and history. Later I refined prompts, changed maintenance tools and added undo for cards I'd closed by mistake. The trial reached V3.2.4; work resumed on V3.1.x after returning to WPS.
最后，还是得照我每天怎么用来改。: In the end, daily use had to guide the changes.
把岗位、资料和处理入口理清。: Clarify roles, materials and where work gets handled.
工具会换，岗位名没必要跟着一起换。我把“知识库维护 Agent”固定下来，又整理: Tools change; role names don't have to. I kept 'knowledge-base maintenance agent' as a stable role, then organized maintenance entry points, rules, navigation and records for both lines. This changed the structure, without re-researching every fact in the knowledge base.
每天采什么得先知道库里缺什么，但每日通读一直没完成。我原来以为已经读过，核对后才: Daily collection needs an understanding of what the knowledge base lacks, but daily full reading never finished. I'd thought it had been read; checking showed only structural checks and some text. I paused daily reading and planning, working from existing audit results instead.
沟通改成一次处理一张卡，回件再接下一张。常用模块也得真能干活，最后把测试执行和回: Communication changed to one card at a time, taking the next after a reply. Everyday modules needed to do real work, so test execution and result review moved into a dedicated testing area. These notes stop at V3.1.23; the workbench keeps evolving.
工作台还在改，后面接着写。: The workbench is evolving. More notes will follow.
